name: blur-agent
description: Agent subsystem for blur-ai-runtime — durable AI-session identity + Turn record + live Reply API + Scheduler (central work queue with routing policy). sendMessage opens a Turn record (canonical 'what happened' log) and mirrors reply chunks into it. sendText returns a LiveReply for host-side ergonomics. The Scheduler is the central queue for all agent work — priority differentiates UI-driven from background AI-only.
